text:
maria: Quick kickoff — we need to lock the fallback / fallthrough compatibility checks for Smart Routing PRD. Customer asks are piling up and product wants firm acceptance criteria by EOW.

aj: +1. My notes: we need (1) region compatibility matrix, (2) tier->model variant compatibility rules, (3) explicit edge cases for mixed-tenant requests.

sam: Can we scope a minimal test matrix first? Happy path is fine for initial launch, but we should list the 5 most likely failure modes.

lina: Happy path tests: same-region, same-tier, pinned-model. Failure modes: model OOM, region outage, quantized incompat, KV-cache mismatch, version skew between variants.

maria: Exactly. For PRD acceptance criteria we should require:
- routing falls back within 300ms of detection for tier1 requests
- fallthrough preserves prompt fidelity for 95% of sample prompts
- no silent degradation: if fallback changes tokens, we surface a warning header

aj: Drafted a compatibility mapping snippet to use in evals:```
# policy samples
- tier: premium -> prefer: rdx-30b-fp16, fallback: rdx-30b-int8, region-fallback: us-west-2
- tier: standard -> prefer: rdx-13b-fp16, fallback: rdx-13b-int8, region-fallback: eu-central-1
```

kevin: One edge case: what happens when preferred model is available but lacks a specific custom tokenizer? We should failover to variant only if tokenizer is compatible, else route to a different family.

sam: Good call. Add that to acceptance criteria: tokenizer compatibility check required for automatic fallback. Otherwise return 409 and trigger route to human ops.

lina: For rollout plan: canary in us-west-2 for 48h, metric gates: latency p95 < 2x baseline, error rate delta < 0.5%, quality regression < 3% on eval set.

maria: Product also wants a customer-facing statement: "Smart Routing will never silently change model family without preserving output format." We need a simple test that validates structured outputs (JSON schemas) across fallback variants.

aj: I'll add a unit test harness that runs the prompt set and asserts schema + token-if-stable checks. Will post PR for review.

infra-bot: deploy triggered for canary cluster: canary-rd-fallback-2026-03-19 (ETA 10m)

kevin: We should create a compact compatibility matrix doc — rows: regions, cols: model_variants, cells: supported|incompatible|degraded. I can own it.

maria: Assigned kevin. Sam own test matrix. Aj owns policy mappings and PR. Lina owns rollout gates and runbook. I'll consolidate into PRD doc and ping legal for compliance note.

sam: One more: add synthetic traffic that exercises KV cache warm/cold transitions; fallback during cold cache can look worse. Include in regression tests.

maria: Great. Action items + owners done. Meeting in 30 if anyone wants to pair on acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
